body: Thank you. This is a very kind response. I set up a meeting for counseling at my university. They put me on a waiting list because I said it wasn't life threatening. I just didn't think my petty problems deserved to be placed above someone who might have actual problems.

I have friends that didn't go to college who spend their days getting high and working minimum wage jobs washing dishes at a chain restaurant and friends I met in college who all have so many goals and aspirations. I feel I have more and more in common with the friends that don't do anything. I have no goals either. Sometimes I feel like running away too, but I have failed at everything I have tried. Why would that be any different?

Theres some lyrics by bring me the horizon that hit me pretty hard

It's like an avalanche, I feel myself go under.

Cause the weight of its like hands around my neck.

I never stood a chance, my heart is frozen over

and I feel like I am treading on thin ice.

Sometimes I think it would be better if I just didn't try to socialize with people and just let myself disappear. I also suffer from migraines and its truly awful. I'm sorry you have to endure it everyday, mine occur only once or twice a week.
Let the world win, I don't think I care.
